summary: RETEST of iteration_8. Both fixes verified: (CRITICAL) realm-client.js auth.getSession() now guards on me.user_id and returns session.user = {...me, id: me.user_id} — with the seeded qa_director session cookie all six surfaces (/app /os /floor /studio /portal /vault) render their live shells, not the sign-in gate. (HIGH) With NO session, each of /app /os /floor /studio /portal REDIRECTS to /login/index.html?next=<original_path> — the dead 'Send magic link' form is no longer reachable. End-to-end Mission Control flow works: add lead → RUN CYCLE hits /api/realm/fn/cycle-runner (real Emergent Claude LLM, ~5-10s) → cycles counter increments → for a Hot-scored lead a PENDING outreach approval is queued (never auto-sent) → Approve button clears it. Portal insert(orders) sends director='PASTE_DIRECTOR_AUTH_USER_ID' but backend realm_router.insert() forces doc['director']=uid so the PASTE_ value is dropped (confirmed at /app/backend/realm_router.py:361-362). OS uses same-origin /app/index.html + /portal/index.html nav and widget SRC = origin+'/widget/yabbai-connect.js' (no PASTE_). Floor renders and shows Director. Vault renders 'being stocked' empty state, no config gate. Hub strip counters read /api/realm/summary and match Mission Control (2 open leads, 0 pending approvals after approving). Admin key inputs on /hub and /revsys start empty.

ensureAuth() in the five surfaces does location.replace(...) then `return await new Promise(()=>{})` to freeze the page during redirect — clean pattern.
realm_router.insert() line 361-362 forces director=uid on orders regardless of client-provided value — the PASTE_ leak is contained server-side.
cycle-runner correctly gates outreach approvals to Hot-scored leads only (never auto-send). Cold/Warm leads increment 'qualified' but not 'drafted'. This matches the spec 'never an auto-send'.

rca of the issue: Iteration_8 CRITICAL was a shape-mismatch: realm-client.js was written to Supabase shape ({user:{...}}) but /api/auth/me returns FastAPI top-level (user_id/email/mfa_verified). The one-line fix now reads me.user_id and returns session.user={...me, id:me.user_id}. Iteration_8 HIGH was a dead in-page magic-link gate on the six surfaces even though this deployment has no magic-link auth (Google + TOTP only) — now replaced with a hard redirect to /login/index.html?next=... The MEDIUM PASTE_ director id in portal is contained because realm_router forces director=uid server-side.
